design.holdout: grouped: the test deal's parcel and its development (same block, build year within ± 1 year, built within 10 years of the deal) are removed from every level and every baseline
design.noLookAhead: every parameter, comparable and location link is dated before the fold cutoff
design.test: OBSERVED street deals of the 6 months after the cutoff, priced as of the cutoff (no forward index)
design.selection: the tier rule, the caps, the rooms feature and the anchor rule were chosen with folds A–C in view: only the fold-C range check (caps and bands from A + B) is a held-out check of those choices; the next register copy's six months are the lock-box test
design.published: the national figures count every test deal the structural tiers would publish, BEFORE the locality caps (a capped locality — e.g. Katzrin — stays in the headline: conservative)
design.asOfData: subsidy-track parcels, OBSERVED matches and the verified neighbourhood links are read from the current data, not as of each cutoff

bRecent.label: recent similar comparables (20 latest, ±25 % area, same new/existing)

bHedLocality.label: the same hedonic translation + index with the locality level only (what the street / block / neighbourhood structure adds)

range.method: the 10th–90th percentile of log(actual / model) of held-out deals in the tier (an 80 % validation-based range for one transaction)
range.localityWidening: a locality with ≥ 300 held-out deals whose own 10th–90th percentile band is wider than its tier band widens the range
